## findings
**T0-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (XF#20, cross-difficulty evidence not producible by the owning charter / supporting records absent).**
- Symptom: the managed and TimeBank rows the rate lock and deposit factors read sit in a world the managed/TimeBank charters cannot produce.
- Root cause / evidence: (1) `managed_agreements/f264dae4…` variant ClearPath Premier, signed 2024-02-15, while `initial_state` has no `security_subscriptions` table at all; `blueprint/products/managed.yaml` `managed_signing_terms`: "ClearPath Premier and ClearPath Enterprise may be signed only while the client holds a Sentinel Managed Security subscription whose status is active." (2) `managed_billing` carries monthly fees only for 2025-06 and 2026-04…2026-10 although the agreement is active from 2024-04-01; the months 2025-10…2026-03 lie inside the twelve-month window client_standing counts ("whose ClearPath billing shows exactly one late fee posted in those twelve months"). (3) TimeBank blocks 872d156b/2b3b2648/3fd7ac60 show block_price_usd and balance_due_usd 0.00 with no `timebank_billing` or `timebank_orders` rows; draws cite tickets SB-4108841, SB-4111207, SB-4113920, SB-4114458, SB-4117733, SB-4119055 absent from `managed_tickets` (remote business-hours support is included on Premier, so a draw needs an out-of-scope ticket). (4) No hardware_client_requests / managed_service_requests intake rows for the signed quotes and agreement.
- Demonstrated consequence: the managed_component (Premier → 10.0) and client_standing (Premier tier) tiers rest on an agreement state the managed charter forbids in this world; the client_standing count of 1 rests on a window in which six of twelve monthly invoices (and their payment/late-fee history) are absent rather than shown paid on time — the skill's "other product's rows the factor reads are absent from the seed".
- Affected: `tasks/project_engagements/tasks/0.json` initial_state (security_subscriptions, managed_billing, timebank_billing, timebank_orders, managed_tickets, intake tables). Relation to previous revisions: first audit.

Observations: O-a DR's base-invariant card is accurate; O-b the rate-lock tool docstring (C9) publishes "0.0" — not gold here.
